top_signals.summary: Ukrainian ex-officer Serhii Kuznietsov goes on trial in Hamburg for allegedly leading group of divers who placed explosives on Russian gas pipelines
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Allan Gray Sees Nigeria Rally Broader Than Korea’s AI Boom
top_signals.summary: Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, sees Nigeria’s stock rally as more broad-based than South Korea’s, offering investors a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Anthropic Investor Day Focuses on Growth
top_signals.summary: Anthropic is holding an investor day as it advances plans for a potential IPO at an approximately $2 trillion valuation, amid growing concerns about AI safety and threats. Momei Qiu of PSP Growth says market sentiment around AI is shifting quickly as new information emerges. Qiu expects discussions to center on the trade-offs between growth and capital expenditures, as well as Anthropic’s anticipated valuation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
